_doc: Screen proofs that a multi-OBJ title sheet is drawn with its cells edge to edge (tools/qa_screen_obj_contiguity.py). aw_fonts.check_cells accepts glyphs crossing these assets' internal cell edges only with an entry here or native-art evidence. Each entry: frame PNG + its SHA-256, the ROM the frame was captured from, cell geometry and the located cell positions.
